title: What did the remote reject?
summary: Identify the exact branch, remote, and rejection before integrating or rewriting history.

choices.label: Wrong remote, branch, or repository suspected

title: Should remote commits be preserved?
summary: Fetch and inspect both histories before choosing merge, rebase, or guarded replacement.

commands.purpose: Update remote-tracking references without modifying the working tree.

title: Integrate remote history safely
summary: Use the team-approved merge or rebase workflow, resolve conflicts, then push normally.
prerequisites: Correct repository, remote and branch confirmed
rollback: Abort the in-progress merge or rebase before retrying; retain recoverable commits and reflog history.
verification: Expected local and remote commits remain reachable.

title: Guard an intentional history rewrite
summary: Fetch and inspect the remote branch, record its exact tip SHA, and use an explicit lease only when collaboration policy permits replacing that reviewed history.

commands.command: git fetch <remote> <branch> && git rev-parse <remote>/<branch> && git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<expected-remote-sha> <remote> <branch>
commands.purpose: Refresh and review the remote tip, then refuse replacement unless it still equals the explicitly recorded SHA.

prerequisites: Fetched remote history inspected and expected remote tip SHA recorded
rollback: Restore the displaced remote tip from reflog or recorded commit ID and coordinate recovery before further pushes.
verification: Remote branch contains the intended commits and no collaborator work was lost.

title: Repository policy rejected the update
summary: Branch protection, review, or permission policy must be satisfied rather than bypassed.

choices.label: Use the approved pull-request or permission workflow

title: Confirm repository and upstream mapping
summary: A valid push to the wrong target is more dangerous than a rejected push.

title: Verify the intended remote history
summary: Confirm the correct branch advanced without losing expected commits.

title: Pause before changing shared history
summary: Record the rejection, branch, remote, and commit graph; ask the repository owner or collaborator before rewriting history.

title: Diagnosis complete
summary: The reviewed recovery checks passed. Record the cause and prevention step before closing the incident.
prevention: Document the confirmed cause and exact recovery.
Add monitoring or a regression check where practical.
